requirements.requirement: Configure node1's system timezone as America/Toronto.
requirements.summary: Direct checks showed the timezone, /etc/localtime target, and zonefile contents all set to America/Toronto. The same state remained after a confirmed reboot, with the system running and zero failed units.

overall_summary: The sole task outcome is fully satisfied. Restart evidence is complete and coherent: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the reboot was scheduled and observed through temporary loss of connectivity, the boot ID changed, and node1 recovered running with America/Toronto retained and no failed units. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Setting the timezone was the required change, and scheduling the reboot served the mandatory restart-evidence protocol. All remaining commands were read-only observations. Lifecycle evidence shows no failed services, damaged package state, new exposure, or unwanted residue; socket and temporary-file differences are normal consequences of the reboot.
